name: Jugendsiedlung Hochland
beschreibung: The Jugendsiedlung Hochland is a campsite in Tirol, Österreich. It is located in the Alpen, at an elevation surrounded by mountain scenery. The surrounding area offers access to hiking trails in summer and ski areas in winter. The complex is geared toward groups and young travelers; the atmosphere is simple and functional. The amenities include pitches for tents, caravans, and motorhomes, as well as sanitary facilities. Group accommodations and common rooms are available. Guests can expect affordable accommodation in a quiet mountain location.
